`final class SignalReplayMatch`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.internal.signal.replay` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [SignalReplayMatch.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/internal/signal/replay/SignalReplayMatch.java)

Result of matching one slice of bytecode against the value a setter received and the signals read before it.

- [How signals work](/use/in-depth/how-signals-work/)

## Creation details

<a id="SignalReplayMatch-factory-of"></a>

### of

`SignalReplayMatch of(SignalReplaySlice slice, SignalReplayRun run, Map<String,String> holeMap, boolean[] consumed, boolean followed)` <span class="joid-qualifier">factory</span>

Returns the match of `slice` found by `run`, with the text of the local variables in `holeMap`, the reads it used in `consumed`, and `followed` when the reads only matched together with those of the arguments that the call evaluates after this one.
